Package com.nexuslink.protocol.db

Class ResultGridExporter

java.lang.Object
com.nexuslink.protocol.db.ResultGridExporter
public final class ResultGridExporter extends Object
Serializes a result grid (column headers + string cell rows) to JSON or CSV for export. Pure and dependency-free (the module has no JSON library), so escaping is done by hand: JSON per RFC 8259, CSV per RFC 4180. Both are total — a null cell becomes JSON null / an empty CSV field rather than the text "null".

Beyond JSON and CSV it also renders the grid as INSERT statements, XML, HTML, and a delimited file with explicit options (separator, quoting policy, header, line ending, and the text to write for a NULL) — the four export shapes SQL Developer offers.

    • toInsertStatements

      public static String toInsertStatements(String table, List<String> columns, List<List<String>> rows)
      One INSERT INTO table (cols) VALUES (…); statement per row, newline-separated. Values are rendered by SqlQueryBuilder.literal(java.lang.String), so numbers stay bare and strings are single-quoted with embedded quotes doubled; a null cell becomes a bare NULL.

    • toInsertStatements

      public static String toInsertStatements(String table, List<String> columns, List<List<String>> rows, SqlDialect dialect)
      As above, quoting identifiers the way dialect's engine expects.

    • toXml

      public static String toXml(List<String> columns, List<List<String>> rows)
      An XML document: a <results> root holding one <row> per row, with one child element per column. Column names are sanitised into legal XML names (illegal characters become _, a leading digit is prefixed), and a null cell is written as an empty self-closed element carrying xsi:nil="true".

    • toHtml

      public static String toHtml(String title, List<String> columns, List<List<String>> rows)
      A standalone HTML page with the grid as a <table> — a header row plus one row per record, everything escaped. A null cell renders as an empty cell marked class="null" so a stylesheet (or the reader) can tell it apart from an empty string.

    • toMarkdown

      public static String toMarkdown(List<String> columns, List<List<String>> rows)
      A GitHub-flavoured Markdown table — a header row, an alignment row, then one row per record. Pipes and newlines inside a cell are escaped so the table stays intact, and a null cell is written as _null_ to keep it apart from an empty string.

    • toDelimited
